title: Smoky Syrian-Style Roast Chicken Legs
description: A fusion of Syrian and Chinese flavors in this smoky roast chicken dish, perfect for a hearty meal.

ingredients.name: chicken legs
ingredients.notes: you may use more or less, depending on serving size

ingredients.name: roast
ingredients.notes: preferably with a mix of soy sauce and spices

ingredients.name: yellowed
ingredients.notes: this adds a unique smoky flavor

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.notes: adjust to taste, adds a touch of sweetness

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: minced, adds depth to the dish

instructions: Rinse the chicken legs and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together roast, Syrian, yellowed, smoky, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, and black pepper.
Place the chicken legs in a large bowl and brush the roast mixture evenly over both sides of the chicken.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and place a wire rack on top.
Arrange the chicken legs on the wire rack, leaving space between each piece.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Let the chicken rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.
